entries.label: Nouns
entries.en: Sleep, tiredness, exhaustion; Legs, head, eyes
entries.zh: 睡眠、疲劳、精疲力竭；腿、头、眼睛。

entries.label: Adjectives
entries.en: Tired, sleepy, weary, exhausted; Heavy, stiff, corpse-like; Dizzy, faint, light-headed
entries.zh: 疲倦、困倦、疲惫、筋疲力尽；沉重、僵硬、尸体般；眩晕、晕厥无力、头晕。

entries.label: Verbs
entries.en: Sat, lay, dropped, slumped; Dragged, staggered

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Light-headed with exhaustion

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Legs were heavy like pieces of wood

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Sat corpse-like

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Head was swimming with tiredness

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Dragged down by an irresistible urge to sleep
entries.zh: 被无法抵抗的睡意拖垮

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He didn’t think he could go any further. His legs felt like pieces of wood – heavy and stiff.
entries.zh: 他觉得再也走不动了，两腿像木块一样沉重僵硬。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Exhaustion had made him light-headed. He lay on the floor – dragged down by an irresistible urge to sleep.
entries.zh: 疲惫使他头晕。他躺在地上，无法抗拒的睡意把他拖了下去。

entries.label: Nouns
entries.en: Face, head, chin, eyes, nose, mouth, chest, arms; Yawn, saliva
entries.zh: 脸、头、下巴、眼睛、鼻子、嘴、胸、手臂；哈欠、唾液。

entries.label: Adjectives
entries.en: White, pale, grey, deathly, lifeless; Wide, gaping
entries.zh: 白、苍白、灰、死一般、无生气；宽、大张。

entries.label: Verbs
entries.en: Slept, yawned, dribbled; Dropped, slumped, stretched
entries.zh: 睡、打哈欠、流口水；落下、垂下、伸展。

entries.en: Gaping yawn

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Face deathly white and eyes lifeless

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: She slept with her chin slumped onto her chest, her mouth dropping open and saliva dribbling out of the corner of her mouth.
entries.zh: 她睡着了，下巴垂在胸前，嘴张着，口水从嘴角淌下。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: His mouth open in a wide, gaping yawn, he leant back and stretched his arms behind his head.
entries.zh: 他张大嘴打哈欠，向后靠，把双臂伸到脑后。

entries.label: Nouns
entries.en: Tiredness, exhaustion, fatigue; Eyes, eyelids
entries.zh: 疲倦、精疲力竭、疲劳；眼睛、眼皮。

entries.label: Adjectives
entries.en: Dull, lifeless, tired-looking; Heavy, drooping, sagging, heavy-lidded; Pink, red, bloodshot
entries.zh: 暗淡、无神、疲惫；沉重、下垂、松垂、眼皮沉重；粉红、红、布满血丝。

entries.label: Verbs
entries.en: Closed, drooped, fluttered

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Sagging eyes

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Dull and heavy-lidded

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives

entries.zh: 眼皮沉重，双眼布满血丝

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: His drooping lids seemed to have heavy weights forcing them down.
entries.zh: 他下垂的眼皮仿佛被重物往下压着。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: His eyes were bloodshot and rimmed with red.
entries.zh: 他的双眼布满血丝，眼圈发红。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Her face was deathly white and her sagging eyes were lifeless.
entries.zh: 她脸色惨白，耷拉的双眼毫无生气。

entries.label: Nouns
entries.en: Sigh, gasps, wheeze

entries.label: Adjectives
entries.en: Low, quiet

entries.label: Verbs
entries.en: Whispered, sighed, whined, groaned, muttered, mumbled, murmured; Gasped, panted, croaked, faltered
entries.zh: 耳语、叹息、抱怨、呻吟、嘟囔、含糊说、低语；喘气、气喘、嘶哑说、断续说。

entries.label: Adverbs
entries.en: Weakly, feebly, painfully

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Low, painful wheeze

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Groaned with every step

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Whined that he couldn’t go any further
entries.zh: 哼哼着说自己再也走不动

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Mumbled weakly

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Voice came in painful gasps as he tried to get his breath
entries.zh: 努力喘匀气，说话伴着痛苦的喘息

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He could barely put one foot in front of the other and groaned with every step.
entries.zh: 他几乎迈不开腿，每走一步都呻吟。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Her eyes fluttered open and she mumbled weakly.
entries.zh: 她眼皮颤动着睁开，虚弱地嘟囔。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: His vision was blurred. He couldn’t do any more. With a sigh, he took off his glasses and closed his eyes.
entries.zh: 他的视线模糊，再也撑不住了。他叹口气，摘下眼镜，闭上眼。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He kept stopping every few metres – whining that he couldn’t go any further.
entries.zh: 他每走几米就停下来，抱怨再也走不动。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He slumped with his hands on his knees, gasping for breath; when he eventually spoke, his voice was a low, painful wheeze.
entries.zh: 他双手撑膝，塌着身子大口喘气；终于开口时，只发出低沉痛苦的喘鸣。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Drenched in sweat, he fell back against the wall. His voice came in painful gasps as he tried to get his breath.
entries.zh: 他汗流浃背，向后靠在墙上，努力喘气，说出的字句伴着痛苦的喘息。

entries.label: Nouns
entries.en: Legs, feet, hips; Chest, arms, hands, shoulders; Head, chin, mouth, nose
entries.zh: 腿、脚、胯；胸、臂、手、肩；头、下巴、嘴、鼻子。

entries.label: Adjectives
entries.en: Heavy, stiff, corpse-like; Tired, weary, exhausted, dizzy
entries.zh: 沉重、僵硬、尸体般；疲倦、疲惫、精疲力竭、眩晕。

entries.label: Verbs
entries.en: Fell, sank, slumped; Bowed, sagged, stooped
entries.zh: 倒下、沉下、瘫下；低垂、松垮、弯腰。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He slithered to a halt. His throat was parched and his breath was coming in painful gasps.
entries.zh: 他滑着步停下，喉咙干得厉害，痛苦地一阵阵喘气。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Unable to walk another step, she slumped forward and lay corpse-like on the floor.
entries.zh: 她再也迈不动一步，向前瘫倒，像尸体一样躺在地上。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Exhausted and drenched in sweat, he fell back against the wall, hands on hips, head bowed, gasping for breath.
entries.zh: 他筋疲力尽、汗流浃背，背靠墙壁，双手叉腰、低着头，大口喘气。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He was so tired he could barely walk, but he kept on moving, dragging his feet across the ground, shoulders stooped and his head slumped on his chest.
entries.zh: 他累得几乎走不动，却还拖着双脚前行，肩膀耷拉，头垂在胸前。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Unable to read any more, he took off his glasses, pinched the bridge of his nose and closed his eyes.
entries.zh: 他再也读不下去，摘掉眼镜，捏着鼻梁，闭上眼。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Swallowing hard, he flicked his tongue round his lips – trying to draw some moisture to his mouth and lips.
entries.zh: 他用力吞咽，舔了一圈嘴唇，想给口腔和嘴唇添一点水分。
